subject: Re: Order Form — invoice split, minimum commit credits & Net Terms exception
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@nebulaops.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@nebulaops.com
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Order form questions: invoice routing and net terms

Hi Karthik,

Quick follow-up from our procurement team after review of the draft order form: two asks we need clarity on before we can route to finance —

1) We need the invoice to be split between our US entity and our EU entity (50/50) for billing and tax residency reasons. Can Redwood provide an invoice schedule or example showing split invoicing?
2) Your standard is Net30 but our treasury requires Net45. Would Redwood consider Net45 on this deal? If not, any alternative (e.g., 60-day payment with early-pay discount) you can offer?

Also, please confirm whether Redwood will accept a single PO referencing the umbrella MSA for both entities or if separate POs are required.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if easier.

Best,
Elena Morales
Head of Procurement, Nebula Ops
Procurement@nebulaops.com

--

(attachment stub: Nebula_RFP_ProcurementChecklist.pdf)

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Elena Morales <elena@nebulaops.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, camila_reyes@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 10:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Order form questions: invoice routing and net terms

Elena — thanks for the clear summary. Looping Ben (commercials) and Camila (legal) to confirm options. Short answers below, details attached.

- Invoice split: we can support split invoicing by entity. Practically we issue two invoices tied to the single order form: one to Redwood US (for services attributed to US entity) and one to Redwood EU. We'll add a line-item mapping table that shows the 50/50 allocation and linked invoice numbers. See attached Commercials_Split_Table.xlsx (tab: suggested-split).

- PO: a single PO referencing the umbrella MSA is fine as long as it lists both bill-to entities and includes the entity tax IDs. Procurement can route to each finance team; we will accept that routing.

- Net terms: our standard is Net30. Ben — can we discuss Net45 for this customer? If not, what trade (short-term credit, activation fee amortization, or early-pay discount) can we offer?

Attached: Nebula_OrderForm_v3_redlines.pdf — contains proposed redlines for the order form (pricing schedule, minimum commit language, invoice split section, and a Net terms proposal).

Thanks — I can join call later today.

Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

(attachments: Nebula_OrderForm_v3_redlines.pdf; Commercials_Split_Table.xlsx)

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, camila_reyes@redwood.com
Cc: Elena Morales <elena@nebulaops.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 08:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Order form questions: invoice routing and net terms

Thanks Karthik — reviewed the redlines. Two options from commercials perspective: 

Option A (standard concession): Net45 for this deal only in exchange for a 1.5% reduction in list price for the first 6 months (applies to token spend up to committed minimum).
Option B (no price change): Keep Net30, but offer an activation credit equivalent to one month of committed spend (credited on first invoice), and allow Net45 for future renewals after payment track record established.

Camila — are there any compliance flags for split invoicing we should be aware of? Also need to confirm whether the activation credit can be amortized across first two invoices from accounting side.

Ben Carter
Senior Account Exec, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

From: camila_reyes@redwood.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: Elena Morales <elena@nebulaops.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 09:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Order form questions: invoice routing and net terms

Ben / Karthik — quick legal check: split invoicing is fine operationally but we will need the following in the order form appendix to avoid ambiguity:

- Clear mapping table showing line items and the % allocation (you already have this in the spreadsheet).
- Billing contact and remit-to addresses for each entity plus tax IDs.
- Clause: "Invoices issued per entity are independent and each entity is solely responsible for payment of its invoice; Redwood may pursue each entity separately." (standard language to avoid cross-entity guarantees).

On Net terms / credits: agree with Option A as simplest but need Finance sign-off for any discount that adjusts committed pricing. If we go with activation credit (Option B), legal prefers the credit be reflected as a separate invoice line item (credit) rather than retroactive price change.

I attached an annotated snippet in the redlines PDF for reference.

Camila Reyes
Counsel, Contracts & Commercials, Redwood Inference
camila_reyes@redwood.com

(attachment referenced: Nebula_OrderForm_v3_redlines.pdf — annotations on pages 2-4)

Karthik — thanks, that helps a lot. Nebula prefers Option A (Net45 in exchange for a small concession) but we had budgeted based on list price. Is a 1.5% concession on first 6 months acceptable to your revenue team? If not we will need to route the PO with Net30 and request longer terms for future renewals. 

Also: we will provide tax IDs and remit addresses once order form language is in place. Could you send a DocuSign link with the redlined order form and the split invoice appendix? Procurement needs the doc to attach to the PO.

Best,
Elena
